    >>> list(drop(2, [10, 20, 30, 40, 50]))

    >>> def iseven(x):

def tail(n, seq):
    """ The last n elements of a sequence

    >>> tail(2, [10, 20, 30, 40, 50])
    [40, 50]

    See Also:
        drop
        take
    """
    try:
        return seq[-n:]
    except (TypeError, KeyError):
        return tuple(collections.deque(seq, n))
